title: OpenAI launches full AI agency with 147 specialized sub agents #openai #opensource
description:
An open-source AI agency was released on GitHub, featuring 147 specialized sub-agents organized into 12 departments such as engineering, marketing, sales, support, and finance. Each agent operates with a distinct role, personality, and tone, enabling tailored responses like writing ad copy or fixing bugs.

This system runs in parallel on platforms like Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, effectively simulating a real business operation powered by AI. The comprehensive setup offers a scalable, modular approach to automating complex workflows across multiple disciplines.

By leveraging specialized AI agents, this innovation can streamline project management, enhance productivity, and reduce the effort of coordinating diverse business functions. It represents a significant step toward autonomous, AI-driven organizations in various industries.
